source.description: C3 user override atomicity regression observed live on 2026-10-02. A valid `/api/preview` for action=stop on run f77c639f283c4abd9f85838e1c2d29e9 was followed by `/api/override`; executor_control physically stopped the run unit first, then the canonical mutation failed with HTTP 503. Result: unit gone/Symphony idle while canonical DB still said work item/run running and retained resource leases. Supervisor had to submit a BLOCKED result to reconcile it. This violates the control-plane acceptance that executor control + canonical mutation/readback are atomic or fail closed. Reorder/fence stop/cancel/delete so mutation failure cannot leave physical executor state diverged from canonical lifecycle, or implement deterministic rollback/reconciliation on failure with tests.
